runs.reason: 报告未识别 GT 的质量相关下落规律：没有比较两球的自由落体加速度、确认重球下落较慢，或提出加速度约与质量平方根成反比，也未说明其对自由物体的适用范围。多数搬运、碰撞、落地和斜面运动记录与证据一致，但若干结论超出证据：冲量 3、1 对应滑行距离约 3.3、0.4 砖，不能支持“近似线性”；第14—15轮的空中水平位移约为 2.5 砖，约4.1砖是包含落地滑行的总位移；第7轮红球仍为 moving，并非已停止。此外，最后两次状态快照只能支持当时终态一致，不能确立“物体一旦静止就保持静止”的普遍结论。

action_errors.reason: 提交的斜面及护栏固定在半空，没有落地支撑或连接墙体、既有装置；执行反馈明确指出最低点离地约0.72砖。该设计以无物理支撑的固定结构充当斜面装置。

runs.truth: Falling acceleration depends on mass: a = g*sqrt(m0/m) with m0 = 1. The heavy blue ball (4 units) falls at half the acceleration of the light red ball (1 unit). At equal initial upward speeds it stays airborne longer and rises higher. Equal applied impulses do not give equal initial speeds: the heavier ball starts four times slower for the same impulse. This mass-dependent acceleration applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.
rubric: notices the two balls do not fall alike
checks that the heavier one is the slower one
rules out size, colour or air as the cause and settles on mass
states acceleration decreases with mass, roughly as one over the square root

runs.truth: Falling acceleration depends on mass: a = g*sqrt(m0/m) with m0 = 1. The heavy blue ball (4 units) falls at half the acceleration of the light red ball (1 unit). At equal initial upward speeds it stays airborne longer and rises higher. Equal applied impulses do not give equal initial speeds: the heavier ball starts four times slower for the same impulse. This mass-dependent acceleration applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.
rubric: notices the two balls do not fall alike
checks that the heavier one is the slower one
rules out size, colour or air as the cause and settles on mass
states acceleration decreases with mass, roughly as one over the square root

runs.reason: 报告未识别GT的质量依赖落体规律：只对红球做了竖直抛掷，没有比较两球的下落加速度，也未提出加速度约按质量平方根的倒数减小及其自由物体适用范围。部分观察有据，包括红球弹道、两球碰撞传递运动、搬运时铰链出现−56°读数，以及建造失败与成功记录；但若干结论超出了证据。第3—4轮蓝球低冲量运动受到与红球碰撞的干扰，不能与第7—8轮直接比较并确立静摩擦阈值。第17轮红球明显撞墙反弹，第8轮蓝球停在边界附近，不能把这些行程当成无障碍摩擦停止距离来支持所报质量或阻力比值。第35轮红球先在约(-3.1,4.2)处停止向北推进，随后才横移至(-3.3,4.2)；最终位置和零铰链读数不足以证明它因漂移错过桨板。另第13、25、33轮释放后的实际状态均为moving，报告却记为静止。故虽有真实的局部发现，整体主张与推理并未得到充分支持。

runs.truth: Falling acceleration depends on mass: a = g*sqrt(m0/m) with m0 = 1. The heavy blue ball (4 units) falls at half the acceleration of the light red ball (1 unit). At equal initial upward speeds it stays airborne longer and rises higher. Equal applied impulses do not give equal initial speeds: the heavier ball starts four times slower for the same impulse. This mass-dependent acceleration applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.
